title: DevBytes
description: A social platform for developers to share short-form programming tutorials, tips, and snippets. Features include code syntax highlighting, community voting, and personalized recommendations.

title: TrackTik
description: A comprehensive task and project management application with time tracking, analytics, and team collaboration features. Includes Pomodoro timer, burndown charts, and integration with popular services.

title: SunoSynth
description: An AI-powered music composition tool that helps musicians generate melodies, chord progressions, and full arrangements based on text prompts. Features real-time collaboration and export to various formats.

title: VerboVisions
description: A tool that transforms text descriptions into visual art using AI. Allows users to generate, edit, and enhance images through natural language commands and sophisticated image processing algorithms.

title: HTML Editor PRO
description: A browser-based HTML, CSS, and JavaScript editor with real-time preview, syntax highlighting, and code optimization. Includes templates, component library, and responsive design tools.

title: PizzaVerse
description: An interactive mobile app for customizing and ordering pizza with 3D visualization. Features include AR view of your pizza, order tracking, and integration with popular delivery services.
